description: Defines the 'precoding_configuration' class which manages precoding patterns, matrices, and parameters for physical channels in a wireless communication system, including constructors, accessors, mutators, and comparison operators.

classes.name: precoding_configuration
classes.description: Manages precoding matrices and parameters for physical resource blocks, including construction, copying, comparison, and modification of precoding weights.

methods.name: precoding_configuration
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing the configuration with specified layers, ports, PRGs, and PRG size, with validation.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying another precoding_configuration.

methods.name: make_wideband
methods.description: Creates a wideband precoding configuration with a single PRG.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two precoding_configuration objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two precoding_configuration objects.

methods.name: get_prg_size
methods.description: Returns the size of each PRG.

methods.name: set_coefficient
methods.description: Sets a specific coefficient for a given layer, port, and PRG.

methods.name: get_coefficient
methods.description: Retrieves a specific coefficient for a given layer, port, and PRG.

methods.name: get_prg_coefficients
methods.description: Returns the precoding weight matrix for a specified PRG.

methods.name: set_prg_coefficients
methods.description: Sets the precoding weight matrix for a specified PRG.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the number of PRGs and the PRG size, adjusting internal storage accordingly.

methods.name: operator*=
methods.description: Scales all weights by a given factor.
